description: List the exNiche gap ledger with filters. detail=summary costs 1 credit per call; detail=full adds exact scores, all linked asks and requirements for 10 credits per scored row. Scores mean 'worth a closer look', not verified demand.

class.description: Comma list of absent, exists_hard_to_find, unverified.

detail.description: summary = L0 (1 credit per call); full = L1 (1 + 10 credits per scored row).

include.description: Also return unscored leads (L0 only, verdict null).

q.description: Words that must appear in the gap label or requirements.

since.description: ISO date or epoch ms; only gaps with an ask since then.

source.description: Comma list of community_ask, agent_search, store_search, bot_research.

trend.description: Comma list of rising, steady, cooling.

verdict.description: Comma list of go, maybe, no-go.

name: list_gaps
title: List scored product gaps
